bio.text: Calvin Schrage has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 12 since 2021 and was House Minority Leader from 2023 to 2024.
According to his legislative biography, he is a third-generation Alaskan who attended Anchorage schools and earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from the University of Alaska Anchorage.
The biography says he began his career as executive director of Frontier Tutoring and joined the boards of the Anchorage Chamber of Commerce and the Abbott Loop Community Council.
